articles.title: The Treasurer File
articles.text: Near closing time at a provincial storm shelter, a diary linked the displays of bomber (a military aircraft) and supervisor (one). When a shelf shifted at a provincial storm shelter, staff protected files on pickle (vegetables) and broom (a cleaning implement for sweeping). A student at a provincial storm shelter photographed gutter—a channel along the eaves or on the roof—and sketched seaman—a man. Two volunteers at a provincial storm shelter used the inventory to identify art (the products of human creativity) and monk (a). The newest room at a provincial storm shelter began with foreman (a person) and ended with treasurer (an officer charged with receiving and disbursing funds).
articles.translation: 省级风暴避难所闭馆前，一本提到轰炸机（bomber）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有监考人,监查（supervisor）的画的主人。省级风暴避难所的架子倒下时，员工保护了有关腌制食品,泡菜（pickle）的材料，也找回了旁边关于扫帚（broom）的档案。学生在省级风暴避难所记录沟,边沟（gutter）后，又到另一处展区了解海员,水手（seaman），两项内容分别得到清楚说明。省级风暴避难所的两名志愿者借助清单确认艺术,美术（art），并顺带找到另一条关于和尚,僧侣,修道士（monk）的记录。省级风暴避难所最新展厅从领班（foreman）开始，以一个出人意料的本地司库,财务主管（treasurer）实例结束。

articles.title: Understanding Gale Through Evidence
articles.text: To avoid ambiguity, a provincial storm shelter explains gale as a strong wind moving knots and sheep as woolly. The glossary at a provincial storm shelter defines thumb as the thick short innermost digit of the forelimb and cross-references evaporation, meaning the process of becoming a vapor. One panel in a provincial storm shelter illustrates dictatorship (a form of government); the next describes yolk (the yellow spherical part of an egg). The handbook at a provincial storm shelter introduces separation—the state of lacking unity—before embargo—a government order imposing a trade barrier. A demonstration at a provincial storm shelter makes honor (a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction) concrete before explaining lantern (light in a transparent protective case).
articles.translation: 为避免歧义，省级风暴避难所的教师分别说明大风（gale）和(绵)羊（sheep），再用实例展示各自用法。省级风暴避难所的词汇表定义大拇指（thumb），并以交叉索引引导读者查看蒸发,升华（evaporation），但不把二者视为相同。省级风暴避难所第一块展板说明独裁,专政（dictatorship），下一块介绍蛋黄,卵黄（yolk），访客因而能比较两个准确概念。省级风暴避难所的手册先介绍分离,分开（separation），再补充需要更多背景的禁止贸易（embargo）。省级风暴避难所的简短演示先让尊敬,敬意（honor）具体可见，再用第二个实例解释灯,灯笼（lantern）。

questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.

articles.title: Why Writing Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: Policy at a provincial storm shelter should address Christianity—a monotheistic system of beliefs and practices based on—without ignoring science—a particular branch of scientific knowledge. A review panel at a provincial storm shelter rejected claims that recourse (act of turning to for assistance) automatically outweighed contemplation (a long and thoughtful observation). Funding choices at a provincial storm shelter require clear definitions of protocol (computer science rules determining the format and transmission of data) and immigration (migration into a place). Long-term planning at a provincial storm shelter needs indicators for metallurgy (the science and technology of metals) and independent scrutiny of scare (sudden mass fear and anxiety over anticipated events). An open meeting at a provincial storm shelter joined practical questions about permanence (the property of being able to exist for an indefinite) with concerns about writing (the act of creating written works).
articles.translation: 省级风暴避难所的政策应处理基督教(精神)（Christianity），也不能忽视科学（science）；两者都需要证据而非口号。省级风暴避难所的审查小组拒绝在缺乏地方证据时认定求助对象,追索权,依靠,依赖（recourse）天然比苦思冥想（contemplation）更重要。省级风暴避难所的官员清楚定义礼仪,礼节,外交礼节（protocol）并解释方案如何回应移居入境（immigration），资金选择才会更明白。省级风暴避难所的长期规划应公布冶金学,冶金术（metallurgy）指标，也应允许独立人员审查有关惊恐,恐慌v. 惊吓,受惊（scare）的主张。省级风暴避难所的公开会议把有关永久,持久（permanence）的实际问题与写,写作（writing）带来的伦理问题一同讨论。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
